title: Acute Inflammation
subtitle: A high-yield guide to vascular and cellular responses

blocks.text: Recognize the sequence, mediators, and clinical consequences.

blocks.heading: Core concept
blocks.text: Acute inflammation is a rapid protective response that delivers leukocytes and plasma proteins to sites of infection or tissue injury.

blocks.title: Clinical anchor
blocks.text: Warmth, erythema, swelling, pain, and loss of function arise from vasodilation, permeability, and mediator activity.

blocks.label: EXAM PEARL
blocks.text: Exudate has high protein content; transudate is protein-poor and usually caused by altered hydrostatic or oncotic pressure.

blocks.prompt: Which mediator is a potent chemotactic factor for neutrophils?
blocks.answer: C5a. It is a complement split product that recruits and activates leukocytes.
